objective: Reduce the build work of unchanged uv through Ohm attribute-macro caching.
required_freeze_before_runs: Final formatted/tested source diff and complete source trees
Matched optimized compiler configuration and complete matching sysroot identities
Fixed Cargo/SDK auxiliary tools, fixture paths and exact command/environment records
Exact reversible equal-length source markers outside the unchanged attribute expansion
correctness_preflight: Focused existing compiler test harness passes, including existing derive-cache cases
Actual uv attribute query loaded from disk on candidate after the controlled edit
Each compiler warms its own independent incremental/shared/build/target state; no cross-loading between versions
All source/tool/runtime paths are identical across arms through task-owned snapshot activation
Original Cargo commands converge without unexpected dependency rebuilds or compiler-identification probes
Semantic output comparison and diagnostics checks pass; any byte-identity exceptions must be investigated and fixed before measurement
Source bytes/mode restored and original commands converge after every stage

primary.case: Ordinary uv-library invocation from a dirty cargo test --no-run build
primary.metric: Whole rustc-process Callgrind final Ir, including its threads and in-process proc macro; compiler children are not included
primary.scope: Isolated compiler invocation, not whole Cargo command or macro-only instructions
primary.preparation: Before every sample, activate that compiler's independent state, converge the original Cargo command on the fixed BEFORE source outside timing, then apply the identical AFTER edit and execute the freshly captured standalone rustc invocation. Repeated AFTER-only replays are forbidden.
primary.environment: Exact fresh captured argv/ordered environment; omit only documented unusable jobserver FDs; no self-profile flags during measurement
primary.normalizer: Existing pinned task-owned Valgrind environment normalizer; no child instrumentation
primary.host_policy: Record competing activity without filtering otherwise-valid instruction samples; balanced orders; no claim of independent scheduling noise

estimator.interval: Two-sided 99% paired bootstrap percentile interval over log ratios
estimator.sign_test: Exact two-sided sign test; eight of eight wins gives p=0.0078125

stages.name: discovery
stages.gate: All four valid pairs improve and geometric instruction reduction is at least 5%; otherwise park the candidate without extending the sample

stages.name: instruction_confirmation_1
stages.gate: All eight improve and 99% lower bound on instruction reduction exceeds 3%

stages.name: instruction_confirmation_2
stages.gate: All eight improve and 99% lower bound on instruction reduction exceeds 3%

native.metric: Uninstrumented complete command elapsed wall time, no tests executed
native.preparation: Warm the same before-source version outside timing, then apply the same after-source edit before each sample
native.host_policy: Reuse the existing prospective pre-command, post-command and terminal quiet-host checks. A failed admission stops before the command; a later failure invalidates and ends the whole attempt before effects are inspected. Keep every output, with no pair deletion or effect-based exclusions.
native.wall_time_claim: Only if both fresh eight-pair blocks for that endpoint have all eight wins and each 99% lower bound exceeds zero
native.regression_blocker: For either endpoint, reject performance acceptance if losses >= 12 of 16 AND the pooled reduction_CI99.upper < -1.0 percent. Pool the two fixed native blocks with equal pair weights; exclude discovery and all instruction samples.
native.inconclusive: Report signed point estimate, interval and wins/losses. Do not infer equivalence or a wall-time improvement from instruction gains.

publication_gate: Correctness/preflight pass, both independent fixed instruction confirmation blocks pass, and no native regression blocker. Publish exact scope, limitations, all valid results and raw profiles in a draft Ohm PR.
retry_policy: No sample-size extensions, effect-based exclusions or retrospective threshold changes. Infrastructure failures retain all outputs and end the attempt; any replacement attempt requires a prospective recorded reason before inspecting its new effects.
limitations: This edit leaves the cached attribute input unchanged; changes inside that expansion may miss the cache.
Matched development compiler builds must be compared with each other, not presented as a speedup versus the distributed PGO/BOLT SDK.
Experimental cache purity limitations remain unchanged; no claim of general tracking of arbitrary macro file/environment inputs.
Hardware counters are unavailable on this host (perf_event_paranoid=4); do not change system policy.
